region_or_platform_notes: Effective 2026-05-15 at 12:00 PM PT. The page does not say when the retirement was announced. The redirect table says `grok-imagine-image-quality`. The caution says requests to the retired slugs redirect to grok-4.3. The redirect table names a different target, and that table is the stored replacement. The same page says that on November 2, 2026, grok-imagine-image-quality is itself retired in favor of grok-imagine-image-2.0. The stored replacement is the May 15 table target. The pricing page says image and video generation are supported in the Batch API but are billed at standard rates.
